description:
## Anaya Pharmacy - Pharmacy Technician

**Anaya Pharmacy** is a licensed retail pharmacy located in **Kyanja, Kampala**, committed to providing quality pharmaceutical care and patient-centred services to the local community. We are looking for a skilled and reliable **Pharmacy Technician** to join our team.

## About the Role

The Pharmacy Technician will support the daily operations of the pharmacy by dispensing medicines accurately, managing stock, assisting patients with their medication needs and ensuring compliance with pharmaceutical regulations. This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified pharmacy professional to build their career in a well-established community pharmacy.

## Key Responsibilities

- Dispense prescribed and over-the-counter medicines to patients accurately, following the direction of a licensed pharmacist
- Verify prescriptions for completeness, check for drug interactions and clarify any queries with the prescribing doctor or pharmacist
- Label and package medications with clear dosage instructions and patient information
- Receive, inspect and store incoming pharmaceutical stock, checking quantities and expiry dates against delivery records
- Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct regular stock counts to prevent shortages or overstocking
- Ensure proper storage conditions for all medicines, including temperature-sensitive and controlled substances
- Assist patients with enquiries about medications, dosage, side effects and general health advice under pharmacist supervision
- Process patient accounts, handle payments and maintain accurate dispensing records in the pharmacy system
- Manage the returns of expired, damaged or recalled medicines in accordance with regulatory procedures
- Keep the pharmacy clean, tidy and organised at all times, ensuring a safe working environment
- Support procurement by preparing orders, following up on deliveries and maintaining relationships with suppliers
- Comply with all National Drug Authority (NDA) regulations and pharmacy practice standards
- Participate in continuing professional development activities and stay current with new pharmaceutical products

## Qualifications and Requirements

- **Diploma in Pharmacy** from a recognised institution or qualification from the Uganda Allied Health Examinations Board (UAHEB)
- **Current registration or enrolment** with the Allied Health Professionals Council (AHPC). Evidence of registration must be provided at interview
- At least **2 years of practical dispensing experience** in a licensed retail pharmacy
- Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical products, drug names, dosage forms and basic pharmacology
- Good understanding of prescription processing and patient counselling basics
- Familiarity with NDA regulations and controlled substance handling procedures
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in dispensing
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a patient-friendly approach
- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a busy pharmacy
- Basic computer skills for pharmacy management systems and record-keeping

## What We Offer

- A supportive and professional working environment
- Hands-on experience in community pharmacy practice
- Opportunity to grow your skills in patient care and pharmaceutical services
- A collaborative team that values quality service and patient safety

## How to Apply

Interested and suitably qualified candidates should send the following:

- Updated CV
- Cover letter
- Copies of academic documents and certificates
- Proof of AHPC registration

📧 **Email:** info@anayapharmacy.org

### Deadline

Applications are accepted on a **rolling basis**. Early applications are encouraged as positions may be filled before any advertised closing date.
